title: Le Creuset, Cousances – Cast iron casserole dish – Rare model
description:
Beautiful vintage Cousances cocotte, a premium line of Le Creuset in enameled cast iron. Production under the Cousances name ended in the 1980s after its integration into Le Creuset, making these pieces rare and sought after by collectors.
Both functional and historical, it’s perfect for everyday cooking and compatible with induction.
As a vintage item, it shows a lovely patina and some signs of use. Please check the photos carefully, as they form an integral part of the description.
